newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close down on central bank move.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close down on central bank move.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended lower on Tuesday after the central bank injected funds into the banking system through open market operations, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate eased slightly to end at 6.583 percent against Monday's 6.752 close, with 30-day commercial paper down to 6.00-6.25 percent against 6.25-6.50.
The central bank injected T$11.75 billion in funds into the banking system on Tuesday.
Dealers said annual cash demand in the run-up to Friday's Chinese lunar new year holiday would slow on Wednesday.
The bond market was quiet with investors stepping to the sidelines before the holidays.
